Subject: Quick follow-up after our RetailOps demo

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for making time today — really enjoyed walking through how Redwood would fit into BlueLoom's in-store inference and price-check flows. Quick recap and a couple of clear next steps so we can move this forward without too many back-and-forths: 

What we demoed
- Real-time SKU lookups at 100ms p99 for 1k qps
- Prefix caching to keep peak costs down for repeat scans
- Integration pattern with your POS (we showed the webhook + VPC example)

Suggested next steps (pick one)
1) 30-min technical pilot planning call (we'll draft a scoped POC + success criteria)
2) 2-week mini-pilot (we provision a dev pool, you send sample traffic)

Also attaching the deck and a short POC outline for procurement to review. If procurement wants a stub of pricing or a one-page SOW, I can send that over by EOD.

Do you prefer a planning call next Wed/Thu or should I send the POC outline and pricing first?

Thanks,
Grace

Hi Alex / Priya — following up on Alex's ask last week (sending POC outline + ballpark pricing). I sent the POC outline attached on the demo note, but want to make this even easier — I'm attaching a focused 1-page POC + a conservative pricing range so you can forward it to procurement.

Short and simple ask: can you confirm whether this is something you want to pilot in the next 6 weeks? If yes, we can provision dev capacity and share an SSO/KMS checklist for your security review. If procurement needs a formal SOW, I can draft one after we align on success criteria.

If it's low priority right now, quick reply with the best quarter for you (Q3 / Q4 / no plans) — that helps us prioritize the right options (free trial vs. paid POC).

I'm around for a 15-minute call any afternoon this week if that helps — here's a link to my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/grace.

Thanks,
